frame.converter: Each sky position at a depth drawn from the spheroid's density along its sight line (frame.spheroid).

spheroid.basis: The spheroid the volume's light is spread through (src/objects/m84-volume/source/experiment.json shapePrior): Kormendy et al.'s (2009) Table 1 major-axis Sérsic fit to NGC 4374 (n = 7.98, half-light radius 142.08 arcsec, 12.3 kpc at 17.9 Mpc), axis along M84's minor axis in the plane of the sky, ending at 3.423 half-light radii, where their Table 3 profile stops. Each cluster's depth is drawn from it, not measured.

meaning: Globular clusters in the Hubble ACS field on M84's centre (Jordán et al. 2009, Table 4, VCC 763, probability of being a globular cluster at least 0.5, the authors' own cut): one dot per cluster at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the Milky Way globular clusters' warm orange.
